transcript: The tongue is so powerful. Speak good over your life at all times. You cannot speak struggle every day and expect blessings to arrive. When you keep saying, I'm broke, I'm tired, nothing ever works for me, your body listens, your nervous system listens, your life responds. Words are seeds. What you speak is what you water. So begin speaking from the place you are walking toward, not the place you are standing in. Say, I am supported. Say, I am aligned. Say, I am being guided. Say, I am blessed. Even before there is proof. This is not pretending. This is choosing which future you feed. And quietly, gently, your life begins to change when your mouth stops working against your becoming. Save this for the days you forget. Comment, seeds, and follow for more teachings like this.
